Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Consultant : 1.Experience of the Firm completed successfully during the last 10 (ten) years as:
a. Design, development, supply & installation or upgrading of online (web-based) real time electronic toll collection system (ETC)
of major bridge/flyover/highway/expressway with minimum contract value of BDT 1(one) crore in a single contract completed over
a period of last 10(ten) years or ongoing project supported by authentic documents.
b. Operation & Management of online(web-based) real time multi-station toll monitoring electronics/computerized toll collection and
traffic management of major bridge/flyover/highway/expressway with minimum contract value BDT 3(three) crore in a single
contract completed over a period of last 10(ten) years or ongoing project supported by authentic documents.
2. Experience of the Firm/s in similar assignment executed/completed during last 10(ten) years in similar operating condition.
3. Availability of the appropriate skilled staff (list of relevant professional staff including their qualification & experience in similar
nature of works) and availability of the resources & demonstration capacity to carry out such assignment.
4. Financial capability & administrative strength:
a. Average annual turnover shall be greater than BDT 4(four) crore over the last 5(five) years.
b. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities shall be BDT 1(one) crore.
c. Company's incorporation certificate, updated trade license, VAT, registration certificate, latest income tax certificate and
administrative/managerial structure with company's organogram with list of staff. Membership Certificate from BASIS/ISO
certification in software development and maintenance/at least CMMi Level 3 certification.
N.B-All experience certificates shall be issued by concerned authority not below the rank of Executive Engr/Equivalent
